subject: Question about identification in multipleGroup() estimation

messages.author: 6e50d514a7c719fe
messages.subject: Question about identification in multipleGroup() estimation
parts:
Hello,

I have a question about identification of the below model [adapted from code in ?multipleGroup]. 

set.seed(12345)
a <- matrix(abs(rnorm(15,1,.3)), ncol=1)
d <- matrix(rnorm(15,0,.7),ncol=1)
itemtype <- rep('dich', nrow(a))
N <- 1000
dataset1 <- simdata(a, d, N, itemtype)
dataset2 <- simdata(a, d, N, itemtype, mu = 1, sigma = matrix(1.5))
dat <- rbind(dataset1, dataset2)
group <- c(rep('D1', N), rep('D2', N))
models <- 'F1 = 1-15'
#
mod <- multipleGroup(dat, models, group = group, invariance=c('free_means','free_var'))

Basically, I would have thought this model not identified. One could compensate for an upwards adjustment in the latent mean for D2 via a downwards adjustment in the D2 item easiness parameters. It feels to me like an additional assumption is needed [as an illustration, a prior for item parameters in D2 centered on their estimates in D1 might work]. Am I missing something?  

Thanks in advance for any guidance on this issue.

Ben

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Question about identification in multipleGroup() estimation
parts:
It's not, but the EM doesn't really know that. Pass SE=TRUE to obtain the information matrix. After, you'll notice that a) the condition number (print(mod)) and standard errors (coef(mod)) will be massive, or b) the model will complain that it isn't identified (for the same reason). Cheers.

Phil
